hero.filename: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers supports local, state and federal agencies following tragic mid-air collision over the Hudson River (3808311478).jpg
hero.caption: New York District's SV Moritz, one of the Corps of Engineers' most technologically advanced survey vessels, supported emergency management and transportation officials in the search for wreckage at the bottom the Hudson River after a tragic mid-air collision in August 2009. (Photo by Chris Gardner, New York District Public Affairs)

(Photo by Chris Gardner, New York District Public Affairs)
